test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He is both diligent ______ efficient.
solution: The correct answer is **'and'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Here, in the given fill-in-the-blank the most appropriate answer is 'and'. • We know that '**both**' is followed by '**and**'. • We use **"both...and"** to emphasize the link between two things. • *Example: **Both** Britain **and** France agree on the treaty.* • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *He is both diligent **and** efficient.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** __ • यहाँ, दिए गए रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति में सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर '**and**' है। • हम जानते हैं कि '**both**' के बाद '**and**' आता है। • हम दो चीजों के बीच की कड़ी पर जोर देने के लिए **"both ... and"** का उपयोग करते हैं। • *Example: **Both** Britain **and** France agree on the treaty.* • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है। [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • 'Hardly/Scarcely' is followed by 'when'. • *Example:​ Hardly did I see him when I stopped my car.* c0:Tced, The correct answer is **'BDAC'.**
